Other parts not fully inspected, so medium confidence.

grade.basis: Independent inspection of full score at pp5,8,12,15,20,23 and all section headings: lower instruments carry continuous slurred semiquaver solos; first violin adds high-register 32nd-note runs, wide ascending arpeggios, controlled slurred staccato, ornaments and harmonic melody; finale requires clean repeated double stops and rapid passed figures. Approximately advanced individual technique, raised one level for exposed four-violin intonation, precisely passed figuration and articulation balance. Optional octave displacement not treated as mandatory. Grade based on notation, never recording runtime.
